redirects._why: The demand lane used to write every page into answers/demand/ regardless of which host the measured demand belonged to. hostFor() answers /answers/demand/* on spryexecutiveos.com, so this page rendered a spryexecutiveos.com canonical while its registry row and sitemap entry said billionairehighperformancecoach.com - the URL and the page disagreed about which host owned it. The lane now picks its directory from the route contract, so a query measured on billionairehighperformancecoach.com is written under answers/phase4/demand/, which hostFor answers on that host. This 301 carries the one-day-old URL to where the page now lives instead of leaving it 404.
Same move as answers/demand/ai-coaching-tools.html: measured on billionairehighperformancecoach.com, so the page now lives under the route hostFor answers on that host.
